_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - copy to labels.json and fill in what you HEAR, before reading attributes.json.
One entry per track_id in the index. null or a missing key means 'not labelled'.
vocals: vocal | instrumental. genre: one of GENRE_CLASSES in attributes.py.
mood: a list from MOOD_CLASSES in attributes.py. energy: low | medium | high,
relative to the rest of this catalog (thirds), not an absolute loudness.
